controls.name: Exact manifest integrity
controls.requirement: The implementation footprint equals the locked 160 STATIC / 173C paths.

controls.name: Generated-path exclusion
controls.requirement: None of the 60 GENERATED / 173D paths exists after Step 173C.

controls.name: Outcome completeness
controls.requirement: Only ALLOW, HOLD, NO-BIND, DENY, and FAIL-CLOSED are permitted.

controls.name: Decision precedence
controls.requirement: DENY precedes FAIL-CLOSED, NO-BIND, HOLD, and ALLOW.

controls.name: No-Bind Governance
controls.requirement: Insufficient authority or admissibility cannot produce ALLOW.

controls.name: Human authority preservation
controls.requirement: Required accountable-human review, disposition, approval, or release cannot be automated.

controls.name: Source disagreement preservation
controls.requirement: Conflicting source snapshots remain represented and are not silently reconciled.

controls.name: RAMAT display-only boundary
controls.requirement: RAMAT Vision cannot approve, release, override, write back, resolve a hold, or bind action.

controls.name: Spreadsheet assurance
controls.requirement: Pending required review produces HOLD or NO-BIND, never ALLOW.

controls.name: Pipette current-state assurance
controls.requirement: Current verification, calibration, intended-use match, and supporting balance may permit ALLOW.

controls.name: Pipette missing verification
controls.requirement: Missing or expired verification prevents ALLOW.

controls.name: Balance day-of-use assurance
controls.requirement: Current checks, minimum-weight suitability, and standards may permit ALLOW.

controls.name: Balance requalification
controls.requirement: Incomplete required requalification prevents ALLOW.

controls.name: Environmental readiness
controls.requirement: Acceptable monitored conditions may permit ALLOW.

controls.name: Environmental excursion
controls.requirement: An unresolved excursion prevents ALLOW.

controls.name: Analytical-result review
controls.requirement: Pending required review prevents reportable reliance.

controls.name: Migration readiness
controls.requirement: Missing restore evidence or operational ownership prevents cutover ALLOW.

controls.name: CMDB authority gap
controls.requirement: Missing ownership, support, or lifecycle authority produces NO-BIND.

controls.name: Power and cold-chain dependency
controls.requirement: Outcome reflects transition evidence, excursion state, and accountable-human disposition.

controls.name: Sanitization and reconstruction
controls.requirement: The package uses synthetic data and preserves independent reconstruction evidence.
